name: Environment Matrix Generator

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      config_path:
        description: "Path to the matrix config JSON fixture to use"
        required: false
        default: fixtures/basic-config.json
        type: string
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 6 * * 1"

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  BUN_VERSION: "1.3.11"

jobs:
  test:
    name: Run unit tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: ${{ env.BUN_VERSION }}

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run tests
        run: bun test

  generate-matrix:
    name: Generate build matrix
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      matrix: ${{ steps.matrix.outputs.matrix }}
      fail_fast: ${{ steps.matrix.outputs.fail_fast }}
      max_parallel: ${{ steps.matrix.outputs.max_parallel }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: ${{ env.BUN_VERSION }}

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Generate matrix
        id: matrix
        env:
          CONFIG_PATH: ${{ github.event.inputs.config_path || 'fixtures/basic-config.json' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          echo "Using config: $CONFIG_PATH"
          bun run src/cli.ts "$CONFIG_PATH"
          COMPACT=$(bun run src/cli.ts "$CONFIG_PATH" --compact)
          echo "Compact matrix: $COMPACT"
          MATRIX_ONLY=$(echo "$COMPACT" | jq -c '{include: .include}')
          FAIL_FAST=$(echo "$COMPACT" | jq -r '."fail-fast"')
          MAX_PARALLEL=$(echo "$COMPACT" | jq -r '."max-parallel" // empty')
          {
            echo "matrix<<MATRIX_EOF"
            echo "$MATRIX_ONLY"
            echo "MATRIX_EOF"
            echo "fail_fast=$FAIL_FAST"
            echo "max_parallel=$MAX_PARALLEL"
          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

  build:
    name: Build (${{ matrix.os }}, node ${{ matrix.node }})
    needs: generate-matrix
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: ${{ needs.generate-matrix.outputs.fail_fast == 'true' }}
      max-parallel: ${{ needs.generate-matrix.outputs.max_parallel != '' && fromJson(needs.generate-matrix.outputs.max_parallel) || 256 }}
      matrix: ${{ fromJson(needs.generate-matrix.outputs.matrix) }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Show matrix cell
        run: |
          echo "Simulating build for os=${{ matrix.os }} node=${{ matrix.node }}"
          echo "Full matrix cell: ${{ toJSON(matrix) }}"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Test harness that drives the environment-matrix-generator workflow through
# `act` for each fixture config, asserts exact expected output, and records
# everything to act-result.txt.
set -uo pipefail

RESULT_FILE="act-result.txt"
: > "$RESULT_FILE"

FAILURES=0

run_case() {
  local name="$1"
  local config_path="$2"
  local expect_success="$3" # "success" or "failure"
  shift 3
  local expected_snippets=("$@")

  echo "=== BEGIN CASE: $name ===" | tee -a "$RESULT_FILE"
  echo "config: $config_path (expect: $expect_success)" | tee -a "$RESULT_FILE"

  local output
  output=$(act push --rm --pull=false --input "config_path=${config_path}" \
    -e <(printf '{"ref":"refs/heads/main"}') 2>&1)
  local exit_code=$?

  {
    echo "--- act output ---"
    echo "$output"
    echo "--- exit code: $exit_code ---"
  } >> "$RESULT_FILE"

  if [ "$expect_success" = "success" ]; then
    if [ "$exit_code" -ne 0 ]; then
      echo "FAIL [$name]: expected act to exit 0, got $exit_code" | tee -a "$RESULT_FILE"
      FAILURES=$((FAILURES + 1))
    else
      local job_count
      job_count=$(grep -c "🏁  Job succeeded" <<<"$output")
      if [ "$job_count" -lt 1 ]; then
        echo "FAIL [$name]: no 'Job succeeded' lines found" | tee -a "$RESULT_FILE"
        FAILURES=$((FAILURES + 1))
      else
        echo "PASS [$name]: exit 0, $job_count job(s) succeeded" | tee -a "$RESULT_FILE"
      fi
    fi
  else
    if [ "$exit_code" -eq 0 ]; then
      echo "FAIL [$name]: expected act to exit non-zero, got 0" | tee -a "$RESULT_FILE"
      FAILURES=$((FAILURES + 1))
    else
      echo "PASS [$name]: exit $exit_code as expected" | tee -a "$RESULT_FILE"
    fi
  fi

  for snippet in "${expected_snippets[@]}"; do
    if grep -qF -- "$snippet" <<<"$output"; then
      echo "PASS [$name]: output contains expected snippet: $snippet" | tee -a "$RESULT_FILE"
    else
      echo "FAIL [$name]: output missing expected snippet: $snippet" | tee -a "$RESULT_FILE"
      FAILURES=$((FAILURES + 1))
    fi
  done

  echo "=== END CASE: $name ===" | tee -a "$RESULT_FILE"
  echo "" >> "$RESULT_FILE"
}

# Case 1: basic-config.json -- include/exclude/fail-fast/max-parallel all applied.
# Expected matrix: cartesian(os x node) minus {windows-latest,node=18},
# plus {ubuntu-latest,node=20} merged with coverage=true.
run_case "basic-config" "fixtures/basic-config.json" "success" \
  '"os": "ubuntu-latest",' \
  '"node": "20",
        "coverage": "true"' \
  '"os": "windows-latest",
        "node": "20"' \
  '"fail-fast": false' \
  '"max-parallel": 3' \
  'Compact matrix: {"include":[{"os":"ubuntu-latest","node":"18"},{"os":"ubuntu-latest","node":"20","coverage":"true"},{"os":"windows-latest","node":"20"}],"fail-fast":false,"max-parallel":3}' \
  '🏁  Job succeeded'

# with a descriptive error and the generate-matrix job must fail the run.
run_case "oversized-config" "fixtures/oversized-config.json" "failure" \
  'exceeds maximum matrix size of 5' \
  'Job failed'

echo "=== SUMMARY ===" | tee -a "$RESULT_FILE"
if [ "$FAILURES" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "All harness assertions passed." | tee -a "$RESULT_FILE"
else
  echo "$FAILURES harness assertion(s) failed." | tee -a "$RESULT_FILE"
fi

exit "$FAILURES"
